name: Minos: Dawn of the Bronze Age

categories.label: VP on track before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track trước khi tính điểm cuối
categories.hint: All VP gained during play incl. Vases, Royal Traits and the round-2 Farm/Region scoring; include +100/+200 tiles.

categories.label: Region scoring (round 4)
categories.hint: Dominance and presence VP depend on Population track (rightmost/leftmost value); add 1/2 VP per dominated region with 2/3 Towers.

categories.label: Sea Peoples battles (VP gained)
categories.labelVi: VP từ trận đánh Sea Peoples
categories.hint: VP rewards printed on defeated Sea Peoples tiles (component values, entered by scorer).

categories.label: Leftover coins, weaponry, cards in hand
categories.labelVi: Xu, vũ khí, bài trên tay còn lại
categories.hint: Add up coins + weaponry + cards in hand, divide by 5 (round down).

categories.label: Cards played but not added to Palace
categories.labelVi: Bài đã chơi nhưng không vào Palace

categories.label: VP on Palace cards
categories.labelVi: VP trên các lá bài trong Palace
categories.hint: Sum the VP printed on all cards in your Palace.

categories.label: VP under built Cities and Ships
categories.labelVi: VP dưới các City và Ship đã xây
categories.hint: Sum the VP shown below each City and Ship you built on the player board.

notes: family: sum-of-categories (end-game phases on top of running VP track). Region and Sea Peoples VP depend on printed components/Population track, so they are scorer inputs. Solo rulebook not modelled.
